description: Attio is a developer platform that lets you create custom integrations, automate actions with webhooks, and embed apps using its REST API and SDK.

mcp.details: Attio hosts an MCP server that lets AI assistants connect via OAuth and use the Model Context Protocol to securely read and write workspace data.
mcp.auth: OAuth (user authenticates as their Attio account)

buildability.blocker: Developer signup / access process is undocumented in the sources reviewed.

evidence.claim: Attio supports OAuth 2.0 flow to generate access tokens
Attio supports generating an API key for a single workspace
Attio supports HTTP Basic Authentication where the username is the token
Attio uses Bearer token in the Authorization header for access tokens
Attio API token can be passed as a Bearer token in the Authorization header
Attio provides a public REST API which exchanges JSON over HTTPS.
Attio provides webhooks (setting up and listening to webhooks).
The Attio App SDK exposes record and workspace data through a GraphQL API.
OAuth 2.0 authentication supported for API access
OAuth flow tutorial for API authentication
Attio provides a hosted MCP server at https://mcp.attio.com/mcp.
The MCP server enables AI tools to connect to Attio using the Model Context Protocol.
Integration uses OAuth authentication to authorize AI assistants.
Attio MCP allows AI tools to search, read, create, and update records in the CRM workspace.
Attio MCP is available on all plans and for all workspace members.
Attio MCP is the supported method for connecting external AI assistants like ChatGPT or Claude to Attio.
